hero.headline: IT services you can hold us to.
hero.subheadline: Liable Tech designs, builds and runs the software, cloud and security your business depends on, with one team accountable for the outcome from the first workshop to production support.

services.title: Custom Software Development
services.summary: Web, mobile and backend systems built around how your business actually works.

services.title: Cloud & DevOps
services.summary: Move to the cloud, automate delivery and keep the monthly bill under control.

services.title: Data & AI
services.summary: Turn scattered data into dashboards, forecasts and automation your teams trust.

services.title: Cybersecurity
services.summary: Find the gaps before someone else does, then close them and keep them closed.

services.title: Managed IT Support
services.summary: Monitoring, patching and a help desk that answers, so your people can keep working.

services.title: IT Consulting
services.summary: An honest view of where your technology stands and a roadmap you can afford.

principles.title: One accountable team
principles.description: The people who scope your project are the people who deliver and support it. No hand-offs, no finger-pointing.

principles.title: Plain-language commitments
principles.description: Scope, timeline and cost are written down before work starts, and you hear about a risk the day we see it.

principles.title: Security by default
principles.description: Access control, backups and patching are part of every engagement, not a line item added after an incident.

principles.title: Built to hand over
principles.description: Documented code, infrastructure you own and no lock-in. You can take the work in-house whenever you choose.

process.title: Discover
process.description: We sit down with the people who use and run your systems to understand the problem before proposing a solution.

process.title: Plan
process.description: You get a written plan with milestones and costs, so you know what you are getting and when.

process.title: Build
process.description: Short iterations with a demo at the end of each one. You see progress and steer priorities throughout.

process.title: Run
process.description: After launch we monitor, support and keep improving, or hand over cleanly to your own team.

contact.heading: Tell us what you need fixed, built or run.
contact.blurb: Send a few lines about your project and we will reply within one business day with next steps.
